messages.subject: Calderwell CV-7 R/2025/118 - 3-month interim review
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

Thank you for the 3-month interim completion report (received 8 December) showing 71% completion (1,519 of 2,140), mostly via OTA. The Branch is content with progress and the priority given to the connected fleet. Please proceed with the January recorded-delivery reminders and DVLA keeper re-check, and continue reporting at the 6 and 12-month milestones.

K. Whitlow, DVSA

messages.subject: FW: R/2025/118 - DVSA content with progress (71%)
messages.plaintextBody:
Good news - DVSA are content with the 3-month position (71% complete, 1,519 vehicles). They've asked us to push on with the January reminders and keeper re-check and to report again at 6 and 12 months. Completion tracker and cost model are in the DMS - net recall cost currently modelled at ~£164k after insurance recovery.

Tom

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
